pitfalls.summary: RESOLVED 2026-11-21 from this file's evidence (Comments introduction, Integrations table): a Wix Blog comment is addressed by appId 14bcded7-0066-7c35-14d7-466cb3f09103 with contextId = resourceId = the post's referenceId. referenceId is a read-only field of the Blog Post object (GET /blog/v3/posts/{postId}: "You can reference the post from other entities, for example, comments"), not the post id. Read it from the imported post (its create response or a GET by the crosswalk post id); sending the post id instead attaches the comment to nothing. Notification behaviour is covered by the site mute.

A reply carries parentComment.id = the Wix id of its parent comment, so parents are written before replies (order by source parent; a reply whose parent is not imported is held or written as a top-level comment, recorded in the faithfulness ledger).
createdDate is the system-database date and shows the import day; the source date goes in commentDate (immutable, date-time).

mappingGuidance: Classify blog comments, page comments, product reviews, and custom-post comments separately.

No reviewed writer: map natively on the guarded raw path (sendGuardedRawRequest) with the fieldContracts[] request shape. Guest authors: contactDetails.email (write-only) on the request; author is a one-of userId / memberId / visitorId and is omitted for a guest.

WordPress /wp/v2/comments also returns comments on non-blog post types. A comment on a WooCommerce product whose parent is a product review is the merchant reply to that review: it goes to the stores/review reply (setStoresReviewReply), not to a blog comment. Other comments on non-blog posts are recorded as gaps.
setupRequirements: Wix Blog app (the posts the comments attach to)

fetched 2026-08-16. Comments are addressed by (appId, contextId, resourceId); Wix Blog is appId 14bcded7-0066-7c35-14d7-466cb3f09103 with contextId = resourceId = the post's referenceId — this is the 'target relation' the relation-required pitfall demands. Guest commenting is supported, so non-member WordPress commenters have a path.

Create Comment schema read 2026-11-21: required comment.appId, contextId, resourceId, content; optional parentComment.id, commentDate, author one-of; guest email in top-level contactDetails.email (INVALID_AUTHOR_EMAIL on a bad address). Recorded as fieldContracts[0].
Get Post schema read 2026-11-21: post.referenceId, read-only, maxLength 24, "Post reference GUID. You can reference the post from other entities, for example, comments."
